leagues.name: Tonga Major League
leagues.note: 8 clubs named for the 2025 season: a source explicitly dated to the 2025 season named 7 clubs (Fasi moe Afi FC, Folaha Marist Kauvai FC, Lavengatonga FC, Lotoha'apai United, Marist Nuku'alofa, Navutoka FC, Veitongo FC), and Nukuhetulu FC is separately confirmed as 2025 league-and-cup double champions. Exceeds the league's stated 7-club size by one, suggesting a mid-season swap not fully resolved in these sources, but all 8 names are explicitly tied to 2025.
